inputs.name: RemoteFailure.constructor.code
inputs.description: A key in remoteErrorMessages that identifies the wire failure. It is stored as the failure code and selects the default display message.

inputs.name: RemoteFailure.constructor.message
inputs.description: Optional display text for the failure. If omitted or nullish at runtime, the constructor uses remoteErrorMessages[code].
examples: The branch moved. Reload it and try again.

outputs.name: REMOTE_PROTOCOL
outputs.description: The wire protocol version used by this remote model. A host answers no other protocol number.

outputs.name: remoteLimits
outputs.description: The numeric bounds for the wire protocol, covering message sizes, request and event capacity, deadlines, connection timing, and pairing. A host also returns these limits from session.attach.

outputs.name: attachMethod
outputs.description: The method name for attaching a remote session. It is included in the projectless method set.

outputs.name: readMethods
outputs.description: Names the methods for reads of a granted project. The list contains listProjects, capabilities, snapshot, entity, history, source, image, evidence, artifact, messages, pendingComments, and providers.

outputs.name: commentMethods
outputs.description: Names a person’s own comment operation and the thread it needs. These methods do not include planning, approval, or a run.

outputs.name: agentMethods
outputs.description: Names planning writes and agent runs. These methods require the agents permission of a grant.

outputs.name: localMethods
outputs.description: Names operations that are never available to a remote device. Folders and hosted credentials stay on the computer.

outputs.name: controlMethods
outputs.description: Names the methods on the desktop control port, which is local connection only.

outputs.name: remoteMethods
outputs.description: The complete set of RemoteMethod names, assembled from attach, read, comment, agent, local, and control methods. Some listed methods are local-only and are never available to a remote device.

outputs.name: revisionMethods
outputs.description: Methods for which a device needs an explicit checked-out revision. The list is limited to createPlan, openThread, approve, and startRun.

outputs.name: projectlessMethods
outputs.description: The methods classified as projectless: session attachment, project listing, deployment activities, and providers.

outputs.name: mutationMethods
outputs.description: Names operations whose answers are remembered by request id. Re-sending one of these methods does not run it twice.

outputs.name: remoteErrorMessages
outputs.description: Maps each RemoteErrorCode to its default display message. RemoteFailure uses the matching entry when no custom message is supplied; wire failure messages are display text without paths or secrets.

examples.method-denied: This operation is not available on this connection.
examples.not-attached: The connection has not been attached.
examples.protocol-unsupported: This app and the computer use different protocol versions.
examples.project-required: Name the project for this request.
examples.project-denied: This device has no access to that project.
examples.revision-required: Name the branch and commit this change applies to.
examples.revision-mismatch: The branch moved. Reload it and try again.
examples.read-only: Historical views and other branches are read-only. View the checked-out branch tip to make changes.
examples.agents-denied: This device may read and comment, but not plan or change.
examples.busy: Another run or change is active in this project.
examples.request-conflict: This request id was already used for something else.
examples.request-expired: This change may already have been made. Reload before trying again.
examples.deadline: The computer did not answer in time.
examples.revoked: This device is no longer approved.
examples.failed: The computer could not complete this request.
